name: export_content
description: Parse table or mermaid content and export to md, mm, html, txt, csv, svg, or png files. Example: formats=["md","html","mm"], filename="sales_q1".

content.description: Table or mermaid diagram text (markdown pipe table, HTML, ASCII, CSV/TSV, or mermaid).

filename.description: Base filename without extension, e.g. sales_q1.

output_dir.description: Directory to write files. Defaults to process working directory.
